detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The battlefield is your playground

Use the environment, weapons, positioning, battlefield mechanisms, and even enemies themselves to achieve victory. Construct spike walls, bait enemies into traps, and push them on hazards or land mines.

Manage your squad

Master all 10 distinct characters and make each run unique by experimenting with squad compositions and different ability combinations. Deploy crazy tech like such as Energy Shields and Time Weapons, and hunt dangerous aliens for loot and glory.

Endless experimentation

Every battle combines different enemies, environments, abilities, and equipment; giving you countless possibilities to experiment with. Discover powerful synergies, or even completely overpowered strategies and builds.

Fight smarter, not harder

Characters move and act on their own, but you have plenty of ways to influence the battle through indirect control. Victory comes from clever planning, positioning, and exploiting every advantage you can find, fair or not.

Develop your base

Every successful run and Station upgrade expands your options. Unlock new quests, weapons, gear, and abilities — each capable of shaping your strategy for the next run.
